subject: Proposal: buyer approval slotting + term-smoothing for AWS Private Offer activation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: procurement@nexahealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: buyer approval slotting + term-smoothing for AWS Private Offer activation

Hi Nora / Nexus procurement team,

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, we want to make the private offer activation predictable for both sides so you can align your procurement windows and internal approvers without causing a multi-week activation cliff. Attached is a short matrix and a recommended cadence. Key proposals: 

- Approval slotting: Seller proposes three 48-hour approval "slots" per week where we trigger procurement evidence handoff and legal signoff. This reduces back-and-forth when approvers are unavailable.
- Term smoothing: For annual vs usage commitments, we propose a 30-day buffer where finance can opt for pro-rated first invoice to avoid billing disputes on Day 1.
- Legal triggers: A single, minimal acceptance trigger for activation (signed PO + approved SOW reference). We can provide template language to avoid redlines.

Attached: approval-slots-matrix.xlsx (shows suggested slot times by region and approver role) and po-term-comparison.pdf (quick comparison of pro-rate vs full-first-invoice models).

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm one preferred approval slot for the first activation week.
2) We exchange templated clause for the legal trigger and confirm with your counsel.
3) We enable a seller-led activation so your internal teams only need to sign once.

If helpful, Ben can run the slotting matrix and coordinate with your procurement calendar.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0196

[Attachment: approval-slots-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet) | po-term-comparison.pdf (1 page)]

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@nexahealth.com>

Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: buyer approval slotting + term-smoothing for AWS Private Offer activation

Thanks Soojin — this looks promising. A few quick clarifying items from procurement: 

1) Approval slots: we prefer weekday morning windows (10–12 PT) because our approvers are distributed across the org. Can you map the matrix to our timezone and the two approvers we care about (Finance: Lydia Chen; Legal: Marcus Doyle)?

2) Evidence pack: we need a short evidence checklist and the SOC2 doc reference so our security reviewer can sign off during the slot. Can you attach the SOC2 link and one-line evidence items?

3) Billing trigger: procurement typically wants the invoice after signatures, not pro-rated billing. If we agree to a pro-rate model, Finance will need a business case.

If you can send a quick delta doc with the checklist and the exact wording you'd like in the PO acceptance trigger, I'll run it with Lydia & Marcus and book a 30-minute approval slot on Thursday.

Regards,
Nora Patel
Director, Procurement — NexaHealth
procurement@nexahealth.com
